The '''Communication Media Manipulator''' was a portable media production tool. It allowed users to create, manipulate, and produce various types of media while on the move. Easily installed in small [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] or [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], it served as an ideal solution for professionals without access to large studios. Whether used for printing posters or enhancing holos, it provided a compact and efficient alternative for mobile content creation.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Communication Media Manipulator was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
